title: Hooks: handle, handleFetch and error handling

videos.script:
A hook is a function SvelteKit calls for every request. {{handle}} The first one writes a log line for each, because a built server tells you nothing on its own. Its first version breaks the build, and the reason is worth knowing: hooks run while the site is being built, too.

Then the hook adds three security headers to every response. {{headers}} Every response, that is, except the ones the server never shows it. You will find out which.

Then a short id for every request. {{locals}} It goes in the log, and it is carried along with the request in locals.

Then the errors nobody planned. {{error}} You will break the planner on purpose, read what the visitor sees and what the log says, and connect the two with that id.

And last, the hooks the planner has no use for, {{other}} named so that you recognise the problem each one solves.
